{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue to detect QA orders
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any QA orders are in the converted group
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]

print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders that are converted: {len(qa_converted)}")
print(f"QA order IDs that are converted: {qa_converted['order_id'].tolist()}")"}
